reviews.review: I was a year late to this game but after a rec from my friend Chewy I picked it up and been having a blast with friends ever since. I love the buildcraft of the game and I've been able to figure out how to even solo bosses on my own with lower level characters. I'd never played a Souls or Souls-like game before this one but I find the dodge mechanics intuitive. And the rings - you can combine so many different styles to completely change how the character plays. Lots of fun.

Im not usually into soulslike games, but Remnant 2 seriously surprised me. Ive beaten it twice now, finished the Dark Horizon and Awakened King DLCs and Im now into my third run on the hardest difficulty. Honestly, im hooked on how the gameplay keeps changing with every run.

Each playthrough feels totally different since Remnant 2 doesnt give you everything upfront. The game practically begs you to replay it, with new paths, story bits, weapons, and secrets popping up each time. The more I play, the more there is to discover.

Unlike typical soulslike games, Remnant 2 isnt quite as punishing, so you actually feel comfortable progressing. The boss fights arent overly difficult, but they are super well designed, which makes the whole experience feel top notch.

There is so much to do, find, and figure out. Its truly a masterpiece.
Great game, fun gameplay, good story.  If you enjoyed the first you'll enjoy this.

The game consistently and repeatedly crashes to desktop on either launch or character load. I can't believe that over a year after release this game still has the same issues as it had at launch.

I had previously managed to work around this by downclocking my processor significantly, which end-users should never really have to do. When I wanted to try the new DLCs, I tried the same strategy, but kept getting those old familiar crashes. The only solution that 'worked' was setting compatibility to Windows 7, but I don't consider choppy 30 fps and multiple minutes long loads to really be playable. Not when Cyberpunk pulls 144 fps steady with psycho settings.

It absolutely baffles me that this issue is still present. Fix your game.
